scope: Seven inspected source entry points; all other profiles remain outside this inventory.

interfaces.input: UTF-8 method source and a closed environment: book, event, schemas; memory_definition additionally required for transition /2.
interfaces.output: lowered_syntax_only or compiled_method with complete method/request and identities; flags executed/committed/admission remain false.
interfaces.failure: Raises core.Invalid; source lowering embeds a physical line number in the reason. It is not a uniform returned error envelope.
interfaces.owner: company_book_transition_v1 or company_book_transition_v2 prepare; execution requires the selected engine propose call.
interfaces.limits: Method compilation is contextual, not eligibility or accounting admission. Only declared monetary operators and memory writes are supported.

interfaces.input: Company source with exact digest-keyed opening/schemas/mapping/memory resources, inline full methods, selected invariant resource, registries and ordered event/report/carry commands.
interfaces.output: compiled_structural containing complete program and source/resource/method spans; execute_text delegates to the exact target runner.
interfaces.failure: compile_text catches exceptions into status=invalid with reason, stage, location and false admission flags. Runtime runner has its own complete/partial result.
interfaces.owner: contracted or guarded authored-program runner selected by exact target profile; method financial effects remain in shared transition engines.
interfaces.limits: Does not itself author the complete invariant, dynamic nested term selection or arbitrary company methods. Later source profiles do not automatically change this parser.

interfaces.input: Company source with exactly one inline invariant block; remaining digest-keyed resources exclude the inline invariant digest.
interfaces.output: AuthoredCompanyText/1 lowering with added invariant-source identity/span and exact restoration of outer source positions.
interfaces.failure: Returns status=invalid and location on compilation failure; delegates execution after structural success.
interfaces.owner: Original invariant_text.lower then common_text.compile_text; no new financial evaluator.
interfaces.limits: The later Unicode repair selects different wrappers; it is not proof that this original /2 module itself was repaired.

interfaces.input: Exact four resource classes plus inline opening, corrected invariant, eligibility, scalar/ordered recipes and ordered event/report/carry commands.
interfaces.output: lowered_structural with selected contract, native input projection, full declarative program and bound call; execution delegates to admitted-program binding.
interfaces.failure: Raises source Invalid(reason, location); binding/executor return stage-aware refusal or complete/partial execution.
interfaces.owner: AdmittedDeclarativeProgram/1 and its composer; selected opening and full command projection are checked before execution.
interfaces.limits: Selected DeclaredReceivableLifecycle/1 correspondence; supplied resources and source selection do not establish actual source/accounting admission.

interfaces.input: SelectedCompanyText/1 embedded source, exact resources and independently supplied reviewed_selection; population status complete/partial/unknown and residuals explicit.
interfaces.output: lowered_structural with derived contract, completeness, complete program and identities; execution calls complete_opening.execute.
interfaces.failure: Raises located Invalid for source/selection mismatch; downstream complete-opening executor preserves its status and delegated result.
interfaces.owner: Complete-claims opening admission plus selected company binding; no inferred actual population completeness.
interfaces.limits: Completeness declaration concerns supplied synthetic population; false actual_population_completeness flag is explicit.

functions.name: assess_source
functions.signature: source, memory_definition, state, coverage, selection, call

interfaces.input: One complete explicit nested-state contract source, memory_definition; assessment additionally needs state, supplied coverage, selection and call.
interfaces.output: Exact structural contract, canonical and insertion-order identities plus source locations; assessment calls structure.admit.
interfaces.failure: Raises located Invalid from nested postorder validation; assess_source returns selected-state admission status.
interfaces.owner: SelectedTermStateContract/1 structural and semantic validators; state admission is separate from source/accounting admission.
interfaces.limits: Does not validate future commands or infer missing population coverage; no source import of opaque algorithm-bearing definitions.

functions.name: execute_sources
functions.signature: contract_source, rule_sources, definition, state, request, coverage, selection, call

interfaces.input: Contract source plus exactly assessment/amendment/collection/carry source entries; definition, complete state, request, coverage, independent selection and exact call.
interfaces.output: execute_sources returns full SelectedTermCommand/2 execution, source diagnostics, per-rule source hashes and contract-source hash.
interfaces.failure: Source/eligibility compile may raise Invalid; runtime failures are inside execution with failed_stage, and construction/eligibility adds source location.
interfaces.owner: SelectedTermCommand/2; ordered eligibility, parameterized constructor and typed transition /2; carry delegates to company_book_carry_v1.
interfaces.limits: Caller supplies sequential state/request/coverage and selection. Carry policy is exactly selected preserve-terms/reset-cursor. This is an existing complete event path, not a missing frontend.

edges.meaning: Full method source lowered for registry entries; contextual compilation/execution belongs to actual command state.
Inline invariant becomes the exact imported invariant resource with translated locations.
CompleteClaims wraps selected-company lowering and binds an independently supplied selection and population declaration.
execute_sources compiles the contract and executes all selected event rules using the same state/coverage call.

Selected-company rule grammar consumes flat eligibility and scalar/ordered recipes; no term-event source dispatcher or SelectedTermCommand/2 branch exists in the inspected runner. A new adapter requires explicit state, coverage, carry/report and selection mapping.
Historical Core 0 debt IR and current method records have distinct schemas/owners; the inspected compiler accepts its named method profile only.
